newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson to improve mobile voice quality.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson to improve mobile voice quality.

text.p: Telefon AB L M Ericsson said it was pioneering an improvement in the voice quality of mobile telephone networks through a functionality called Enhanced Full Rate.

"Traditionally the voice quality of land line telephone services has been viewed as superior to that of mobile telephony," it said in a statement, but the improvements were a first step towards changing this.
"Our vision of wireless is that it will soon offer the same or even better voice quality as that of many landline telephone networks," Ericsson said.
Enhanced Full Rate required no more bandwidth than ordinary full services and was fully compliant with North American and European standardisation rules.

The Swedish company will also provide mobile phones for the new technology, which is based on a new speech codec and improvements to the existing signalling protocols. -- Tony Austin, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
